bible_verses.telugu: ఏలయనగా ఆకాశమందున్నవియు భూమియందున్న వియు, దృశ్యమైనవిగాని, అదృశ్యమైనవిగాని, అవి సింహాసనములైనను ప్రభుత్వములైనను ప్రధానులైనను అధికారములైనను, సర్వమును ఆయనయందు సృజింప బడెను, సర్వమును ఆయనద్వారాను ఆయననుబట్టియు సృజింపబడెను. ఆయన అన్నిటికంటె ముందుగా ఉన్న వాడు; ఆయనే సమస్తమునకు ఆధారభూతుడు.
bible_verses.english: For in him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through him and for him. He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.

bible_verses.telugu: అందుచేతను పరలోకమందున్నవారిలో గాని, భూమిమీద ఉన్నవారిలో గాని,
bible_verses.english: Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆదియందు వాక్యముండెను, వాక్యము దేవునియొద్ద ఉండెను, వాక్యము దేవుడై యుండెను.
bible_verses.english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, You are exalted above every throne, power, and treasure this world has to offer. Forgive me for the times I place my trust in temporary things rather than in Your unmatched worth. Realign my heart today to honor Jesus as supreme above all else. May my life reflect the awe and gratitude I feel for the One who holds all of creation together. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Before creation was spoken into being, Jesus existed in perfect power and majesty. He stands far above every earthly kingdom, human wisdom, and worldly treasure, possessing a worth beyond all measure. Yet, the supreme Lord of all creation chose to draw near to us in humility and sacrificial love. As we sing these words, we are invited to lift our eyes above our temporary worries and surrender our lives to the One who reigns supreme over all things.
